intent: Add a Docker-backed MySQL 8.0.33 practice harness that grades SQL by exact output match, with 12 original drills.
scope: meta/pyproject.toml: register the docker pytest marker
Non-goal: bumping the pinned mysql image; copying third-party problems
changes: CLI start/stop/list/show/check over one long-lived tmpfs container
Judge-style normaliser and line diff, unit-tested without Docker
12 original drills with live-verified reference solutions kept in tests only

verification.evidence: 71 passed, 16 of them live against mysql:8.0.33; package coverage 100% branch

verification.command: python3 -m python_pkg.sql_drills check <id> <reference> for all 12 drills
verification.evidence: every drill prints PASS; wrong query prints a line diff, syntax error exits 2

risks: Local MySQL image must be pulled once; start fails with a clear error otherwise
A runaway query is cut off client-side after 30 s but may keep running in the container until stop
rollback: git revert the commit; run python3 -m python_pkg.sql_drills stop first
Check that pytest still collects with the marker line removed
